scientific_integrity: Exact recurrence checker uses only integer arithmetic and confirms 2235 finite parameter pairs; the infinite proof is by valuation and ratio-rigidity arguments. Unindexed equivalent deductions from the known closed form remain a priority risk. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The known rotating-memory scalar block formula is credited; the contribution is the exact least eventual modular period and least onset for all moduli and memory lengths at least two. The result does not generalize automatically to arbitrary memory patterns or imply a new closed form for the sequence.
title: Exact least modular periods and preperiods of rotating-memory Fibonacci numbers
